name: AA Intelligence Index
blurb: One number over a fixed suite of benchmarks run by Artificial Analysis rather than the model vendors; higher is better.

name: AA Coding Index
blurb: Artificial Analysis composite for coding tasks as shown by one aggregator; its component tests are not recorded yet.

name: AA Agentic Index
blurb: Artificial Analysis composite for multi-step agentic tasks as shown by one aggregator; its component tests are not recorded yet.

name: AA Cost per task
blurb: USD Artificial Analysis spent running its task suite on this model at the stated effort setting; lower is cheaper. It reflects how many tokens the model uses, not only its price per token.

name: AA Time per task
blurb: Minutes the same suite took end to end at the stated effort setting; lower is faster.

name: AA First answer token
blurb: Seconds until the first token of the final answer arrives, after any reasoning; lower is quicker. High-effort reasoning modes can take minutes.

name: GPQA Diamond
blurb: 198 graduate-level science questions written to resist web search.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
blurb: 2,500 expert-written questions across maths, science and the humanities.

name: AIME 2025
blurb: Competition mathematics problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination.

name: MMLU-Pro
blurb: A harder, ten-option version of the MMLU general-knowledge multiple-choice test.

name: ARC-AGI-2
blurb: Novel grid puzzles that test reasoning on tasks the model has not seen.

name: SWE-bench Verified
blurb: Real GitHub issues a model must fix so the project's tests pass; human-verified subset.

name: SWE-bench Pro
blurb: A harder, less contaminated set of software-engineering issues than SWE-bench Verified.

name: LiveCodeBench
blurb: Fresh competitive-programming problems released after model training cutoffs.

name: Terminal-Bench
blurb: Multi-step tasks completed in a real command-line environment.

name: Context window
blurb: Longest input the model accepts, in thousands of tokens, as listed by Artificial Analysis.

name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
blurb: Multi-step tasks in a real command-line environment, run by Artificial Analysis; % solved.

name: AutomationBench
blurb: Artificial Analysis's business-automation tasks across tools and apps; partial-credit score in %.

name: AA-Briefcase
blurb: Agentic knowledge work (analyst-style briefs) judged head to head; an Elo rating, higher is better.

name: FrontierCode 2.0
blurb: Hard, recent software-engineering tasks; % solved.

name: SciCode
blurb: Scientific programming problems from research code; % of sub-problems solved.

name: HLE-Diamond
blurb: The hardest verified subset of Humanity's Last Exam; % correct.

name: Humanity's Last Exam
blurb: 2,500 expert-written questions across maths, science and the humanities; % correct.

name: CritPt v2 (hard)
blurb: Research-level physics problems, hard subset; % correct.

name: Terminal-Bench Science
blurb: Scientific computing tasks in a terminal; % solved.

name: Long-context reasoning
blurb: Artificial Analysis's reasoning questions over very long documents; % correct.

name: GDP.pdf
blurb: Answering questions from long economic PDF reports; % fully correct.

name: MMMU-Pro
blurb: College-level questions that need images and text together; % correct.

name: AA-Omniscience
blurb: Knowledge reliability: correct answers minus hallucinations, -100 to 100; refusing costs nothing.

name: Non-hallucination rate
blurb: Share of AA-Omniscience questions it did not answer wrongly (100 minus the hallucination rate); %.
